faqs.q: How long does SEO take to work in Sweden?
faqs.a: Most Swedish businesses see early movement in 2 to 3 months and meaningful results in 4 to 6. Stockholm's competitive keywords take longer; Gothenburg, Malmö, and regional markets often move faster because fewer businesses invest properly in Swedish-language SEO.

faqs.q: Should my website be in Swedish or English?
faqs.a: Swedish, for anything targeting local customers. Nearly all local searches in Sweden happen in Swedish, even though most Swedes speak excellent English. An English version is a fine extra for B2B or international clients, but the Swedish pages do the ranking work.

faqs.q: Do Swedes use Google, or a local search engine?
faqs.a: Google dominates completely. Unlike some European markets with strong local engines, Sweden is a Google market, which keeps the technical playbook familiar: Business Profile, reviews, Swedish content, and clean site structure.

faqs.q: How important are reviews for ranking in Sweden?
faqs.a: Very. Swedish buyers research heavily before contacting anyone, and Google weighs review quantity, recency, and responses in local rankings. A steady flow of genuine Swedish-language reviews is one of the highest-leverage things a local business can build.

faqs.q: Can you help a business outside Stockholm?
faqs.a: Yes, and those are often my favourite projects. Competition outside Stockholm is thinner, so focused Swedish-language local SEO in Gothenburg, Malmö, Uppsala, or further north can win page one faster than most owners expect.
